summary: The user followed a download link provided inside a Claude chat while installing a transcription application and pasted a command into the terminal. A copycat site delivered malware that attempted to steal data and also planted a poisoned SKILL.md containing instructions to reinstall the malware and steal credentials after restoration.
user_mistake: executed a terminal command from an unverified software download site
prevention: Confirm software downloads against the developers official domain before executing terminal commands / Inspect restored AI agent configuration files before execution
